verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's pricing page confirms segmentation is included even on the free plan, and Composer can 'build the audience'. Separate docs show profile and event data being ingested (event-tracking API, mobile SDK profile identification and event tracking, schemaless arbitrary data), but nothing connects that data to how segments are defined. Missing for 10: documentation of segment conditions on profile attributes, tags, and behavioral events; evidence that segments update live as data changes; any hands-on or independent corroboration.
